## Body

Security review of #281 at ed493731a221dc57a17811962203ee07ff925429: retries must re-observe binding evidence, never carry a successful identity snapshot across ticks. CodexBinder reloads pending rows and spawn evidence, then rechecks child parent, unique writer-lock thread, conversation, pane wrapper PID and child start (crates/daemon/src/codex_bind.rs:238-342); ordinary registration also rechecks process start and related rows under exclusion (crates/daemon/src/registration.rs:1039-1089). A new wrapper in a reused pane does not satisfy the old spawn. Registration refusals are decisions, not retryable admissions. This is ordinary registration strength, not independent argv/cwd attestation or an exact pending-tuple compare at commit; do not upgrade the proof grade. C33 accepts same-user authority as the baseline. The predecessor lesson Unknown observations must preserve retry state records F232. Difficulties and magicWand: the existing Dependency-free review readiness gap recurred; local checks selected absent or globally mismatched TS tools while exact-head CI passed. Retain the proposed scoped read-only review mode rather than repairing shared dependencies. No product files changed; local security proof is source inspection plus exact-head CI, not peer-owned Busy or mutant execution.
